articles.summary: Nucor Corporation (NYSE: NUE) announced today that it is expanding production at its Nucor Towers Structures facility in Crawfordsville, Indiana, pending receipt of regulatory and other approvals. The additional $105 million investment will add capacity to manufacture utility poles and related products that support the nation's power transmission and distribution infrastructure. This investment is expected to create 100 new jobs paying average annual wages of $87,500. "The expansion of our Indiana facility reflects the strong demand we are seeing in the utility market," said Leon Topalian, Chair and Chief Executive Officer of Nucor Corporation. "Utilities across the country are making significant investments to modernize the electric grid and meet growing electricity demand. By expanding our Crawfordsville operations and investing in advanced manufacturing and automation, we are strengthening our ability to serve our customers and support their long-term infrastructure needs."
articles.title: Nucor to Expand Utility Towers & Structures Facility in Indiana

articles.summary: Nucor Corporation (NYSE: NUE) announced that it will invest $60 million to expand its Nucor Towers Structures facility in Trinity, Alabama, subject to regulatory and other approvals. The project will add 60 jobs with average annual wages exceeding $87,000 and increase production of steel poles and other steel structures for utility infrastructure. "Utilities across the country are making significant investments to strengthen and modernize the nation's power grid," said Leon Topalian, Chair and Chief Executive Officer of Nucor Corporation. "By expanding our Trinity facility adjacent to our Decatur sheet mill, we can combine American-made steel with highly efficient manufacturing to better serve our utility customers and support their long-term infrastructure needs. This investment also builds on Nucor's longstanding commitment to Alabama and its communities." The Nucor Towers Structures facility began operations in September 2025 and is located adjacent to Nucor Steel
articles.title: Nucor Expands Alabama Towers & Structures Facility to Meet Growing Demand for Utility Infrastructure
